module_summary: Direct-mapped write-through cache: a 5-state FSM latches CPU requests, checks tag/valid arrays, refills misses and writes through via a req/ack memory port.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/LOOKUP/WRITE_MEM/REFILL/RESPOND controller driving handshakes, memory requests, array updates.

anchors.name: data_array
anchors.why: Cached data lines, filled on refill and updated on write hits.

anchors.name: tag_array
anchors.why: Per-line tags written on refill and compared for hit detection.

anchors.name: valid_bits
anchors.why: Per-line valid bits set on refill, qualify hit.

anchors.name: hit
anchors.why: Tag match with valid; selects RESPOND vs REFILL and gates write-hit updates.

anchors.name: addr_q
anchors.why: Latched request address providing index/tag and the memory address.

anchors.name: wdata_q
anchors.why: Latched write data sent to memory and written into data_array on hit.

anchors.name: we_q
anchors.why: Latched write flag steering FSM to WRITE_MEM write-through path.

anchors.name: index
anchors.why: Line index from addr_q addressing tag, data and valid arrays.

anchors.name: tag
anchors.why: Address tag field compared against tag_array and stored on refill.

anchors.name: rdata_q
anchors.why: Response data register muxed from hit data, refill data or write data.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request valid; starts lookup and latches request fields.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Ready when FSM idle.

anchors.name: cpu_we
anchors.why: Request write/read type latched into we_q.

anchors.name: cpu_addr
anchors.why: CPU request address latched into addr_q.

anchors.name: cpu_wdata
anchors.why: CPU write data latched into wdata_q.

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: Response valid pulse in RESPOND state.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: Read response data from rdata_q.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Stall indication while lookup or memory access in progress.

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request during REFILL or WRITE_MEM.

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge completing refill/write and advancing FSM.

anchors.name: mem_we
anchors.why: Memory write strobe for write-through accesses.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Memory address from latched addr_q.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Write-through data from wdata_q.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Refill data written to data_array and rdata_q.

groups.name: cache_fsm
groups.description: Sequences lookup, write-through, refill and response; generates handshakes.

groups.name: cache_arrays
groups.description: Tag, data and valid storage for 16 direct-mapped lines.

groups.name: hit_logic
groups.description: Splits address into index/tag and compares against stored tag and valid.

groups.name: request_latch
groups.description: Holds accepted CPU request address, data and write flag.

groups.name: response_path
groups.description: Selects and registers read data returned to CPU.
